title: 第三章 规矩如刀破局争先第四章 夜入荒山险中求机
lines: 翌日，天刚破晓。
青阳城的晨雾轻薄微凉，漫过镇北侯府的层层飞檐，将整座恢弘府邸笼罩在一片朦胧静谧之中。寅时三刻，侯府演武堂准时开堂，清脆的铜钟声响彻府邸内外，打破了清晨的沉寂。
侯府子弟无论嫡庶长幼，除却重病重伤，皆需准时到场，每日晨练、点卯、核验修为，这是镇北侯府传承百年的铁规，无人能够例外。
昨日演武场一战的风波，并未随着夜雨落幕，反而如同投入静水的巨石，整夜发酵，在府中层层蔓延。几乎所有侯府子弟都知晓了那件颠覆认知的事——蛰伏十年、懦弱平庸的大房遗孤沈砚，一朝出手，碾压三房嫡子沈浩，实力深不可测。
流言四起，人心浮动。有人好奇窥探，有人敬畏观望，更多的是三房势力暗中引导的猜忌与疏离。短短一夜，一句“沈砚心机深沉、隐忍养锐，城府可怖”的评价，悄然传遍了整个侯府。
无数人暗中观望，等着看三房的后续手段，看这位骤然崛起的少年，能否扛住即将到来的打压与困局。
静思院木门轻开，沈砚缓步走出。
一身干净利落的青色武服，束发整齐，身姿挺拔如松，眉眼清冷沉静，不见半分少年浮躁。一夜打坐调息，他气血充盈内敛，周身气息愈发沉稳，卡在淬体五重巅峰的修为稳稳夯实，距离突破仅差一线机缘。
他眼底无波无澜，看似一如既往的平淡，心中却早已推演好了今日所有局势。
柳氏昨夜必然定下对策，不会明面寻衅落人口实，只会借侯府规矩、演武堂制度，名正言顺地掐断他的修炼资源，将他彻底孤立。
规矩，是弱者的枷锁，是强者的阶梯，更是世家博弈最锋利、最干净的刀。
柳氏深谙此道，而沈砚，早已看透其中所有门道。
他从不畏惧明面的厮杀打斗，真正让他十年隐忍、步步谨慎的，从来都是这种藏在规矩之下、无影无形的算计。明枪易躲，暗箭难防，制度的刻意倾斜，远比拳脚的打压更难应对。
一路前行，沿途偶遇的府中子弟尽数侧身避让，低声窃语，目光躲闪，没人再敢像从前那般肆意轻视、嘲讽挑衅，却也无人敢上前攀谈结交。三房的暗流施压，已然初见成效，所有人都在刻意疏远他，生怕卷入这场嫡庶博弈，得罪势大的三房。
人情冷暖，世态炎凉，在这座金碧辉煌的侯府之中，展现得淋漓尽致。
沈砚对此视若无睹，心底毫无波澜。十年孤苦，他早已习惯了孤身一人，从不寄望旁人善意，更不屑所谓的趋炎附势。真正的强者，从不需要旁人簇拥，自身立足，便是万丈高台。
抵达演武堂时，场中已然齐聚数十名侯府同辈子弟，分列两侧，井然有序。往日松散喧闹的演武场，今日气氛格外凝重压抑，所有人的目光，都若有若无地聚焦在入口处的沈砚身上。
左侧队列之首，沈浩一身华贵白锦武服，面色冰冷，眼底藏着未消的阴戾与屈辱。他昨夜被柳氏严加训斥，强行压下了所有报复的冲动，此刻看似平静站立，实则心神紧绷，死死盯着缓步入场的沈砚。
他身旁的几名三房嫡系子弟，皆是面色不善，眼神带着明显的敌意与挑衅，隐隐形成合围之势。
演武堂执事赵坤，一名淬体七重的老牌武者，执掌侯府演武堂奖惩、资源分配大权多年，素来处事圆滑，依附三房势力，是柳氏一手提拔起来的人。此刻他面色严肃，立在高台之上，目光扫过全场，最终定格在沈砚身上，带着不加掩饰的刻意冷淡。
沈砚心中了然，果然如他所料，今日的打压，会从演武堂的规矩与资源开始。
不多时，晨钟落音，点卯正式开始。
赵坤手持名册，沉声点名，声音洪亮，传遍全场。流程有条不紊，直到最后一人，他缓缓抬眼，目光落在孤身站立、无队列依附的沈砚身上。
“沈砚，昨日演武场私斗，惊扰堂规，破坏习武风气，罚本月月例减半，取消本月淬体丹药分配资格。”
一句话落下，全场瞬间寂静。
没有审问，没有对峙，没有查证始末，仅凭一句轻飘飘的“私斗扰规”，便直接定罪罚处。
在场所有人都心知肚明，昨日之事分明是沈浩无端寻衅、蓄意栽赃，沈砚全程被动防守、点到为止，从未主动生事。可此刻执掌规矩的人偏向三房，是非对错，便彻底颠倒。
规矩是人定的，人心偏了，规矩便成了伤人的利器。
沈浩唇角勾起一抹隐晦的冷笑，眼底满是得意与讥讽。这便是他母亲的手段，不用动手，不用结怨，仅凭手中权柄，便能名正言顺地打压对手，让沈砚有苦说不出。
四周子弟纷纷低头，无人敢出声辩驳，人人噤若寒蝉，默认了这场不公的惩处。
全场唯有沈砚，依旧身姿挺拔，神色平静，没有半分慌乱与愤怒。
他抬眼望向高台之上的赵坤，声音清冷平稳，不高不低，清晰传遍整座演武场：“敢问执事，堂规第三条明确标注，被动自卫、抵御寻衅者，不视作私斗，免于惩处。昨日全程众人共睹，是沈浩带人围堵、无端栽赃、率先出手，我只是自保防守，何来私斗之说？”
字字清晰，句句有据，精准扣住演武堂明文规矩，没有半分无理取闹。
赵坤神色微僵，显然没料到素来隐忍沉默的沈砚，竟敢当众顶撞自己，公然质疑堂规惩处。他眼底掠过一丝不悦，随即冷声道：“无论起因如何，打斗已成事实，惊扰演武堂秩序，便是违规。规矩之下，只看结果，不究琐碎过程！”
强词夺理，蛮横压人。
在场众人听得清清楚楚，心中皆明，这便是赤裸裸的针对与打压。可无人敢质疑执事权威，更无人敢得罪背后的三房势力。
沈砚眼底掠过一抹极淡的寒芒，心中思绪飞速流转。
赵坤此举，看似临时决断，实则是柳氏昨夜的安排。先用最轻的惩处名义，扣掉他最急需的淬体丹药，断掉他突破境界的关键资源，同时试探他的底线与胆量。
若他忍气吞声，便会被认定为依旧懦弱可欺，后续的打压会层层加码，资源、历练、功法尽数被截，最终被困死在淬体五重，再无进阶可能。
若他激烈反抗，便会被扣上藐视堂规、顶撞执事、狂妄悖逆的罪名，罪加一等，彻底剥夺演武堂习武资格，得不偿失。
一柔一刚，两路死局，步步陷阱，层层算计。
柳氏的手段，阴柔缜密，滴水不漏，狠毒至极。
换做寻常少年，要么忍辱负重、任由拿捏，要么血气上涌、落入圈套。但沈砚十年城府，最擅长的就是绝境破局、逆势而为。
他从不冲动，从不逞凶，却也绝不忍辱吞声。
content_en:
The next day, it was just dawn.
The morning mist in Qingyang City was light and cool, flowing over the layers of cornices of the Zhenbei Hou Mansion, shrouding the entire grand mansion in hazy silence. At three o'clock in the morning, the martial arts hall of the Hou Mansion opened on time, and the clear sound of copper bells resounded inside and outside the mansion, breaking the silence of the early morning.
The children of the Hou Mansion, regardless of whether they are young or old, are required to arrive on time, unless they are seriously ill or injured. They do morning exercises, do the math, and check their cultivation every day. This is an iron rule passed down by the Hou Mansion in Zhenbei for hundreds of years, and no one can make an exception.
The turmoil of yesterday's martial arts battle did not end with the night rain. Instead, it fermented all night and spread throughout the house like a boulder thrown into still water. Almost all the children of the Hou family knew about the incident that subverted their understanding - Shen Yan, the cowardly and mediocre orphan of the first house who had been dormant for ten years, took action and crushed the legitimate son of the third house, Shen Hao, with unfathomable strength.
Rumors spread and people's hearts wandered. Some people are curious and snooping, while others are watching in awe. Most of them are jealous and alienated from the secret guidance of the three-fang forces. In just one night, the comment "Shen Yan has a deep scheming mind, forbears and cultivates strength, and the city is terrifying" quietly spread throughout the entire Hou Mansion.
Countless people were secretly watching, waiting to see what Sanfang would do next, to see if this young man who had suddenly risen could withstand the upcoming pressure and difficulties.
The wooden door of Jingsi courtyard opened slightly, and Shen Yan walked out slowly.
He is wearing a neat blue military uniform, his hair is tied neatly, his posture is as tall and straight as a pine tree, his eyebrows are cold and calm, and there is no hint of youthful impatience. After a night of meditating and adjusting his breath, his energy and blood were full and restrained, and the aura around his body became more and more stable. His cultivation stuck at the fifth level of body tempering was firmly consolidated, and he was only one chance away from a breakthrough.
His eyes were calm and calm as always, but in his mind he had already deduced all the situations today.
Mrs. Liu must have decided on a countermeasure last night. She would not openly provoke him and prove it, but would only use the rules of the Marquis Mansion and the martial arts hall system to cut off his training resources and completely isolate him.
Rules are the shackles of the weak, the ladder for the strong, and the sharpest and cleanest knife in family games.
Mrs. Liu is well versed in this, and Shen Yan has already seen through all the ways.
He was never afraid of fighting openly. What really made him endure for ten years and be cautious every step of the way was always this kind of invisible calculation hidden under the rules. It is easy to hide from open guns, but difficult to guard against hidden arrows. The deliberate tilt of the system is far more difficult to deal with than the suppression of fists and kicks.
Along the way, all the children of the mansion who met along the way turned aside, whispered, and avoided their eyes. No one dared to look down upon, ridiculed and provoked as before, but no one dared to come forward to talk and make friends. The undercurrent of pressure from Sanfang has begun to bear fruit. Everyone is deliberately alienating him, for fear of getting involved in this concubine game and offending the powerful Sanfang.
The warmth and coldness of human relationships and the harshness of the world are vividly displayed in this magnificent palace.
Shen Yan turned a blind eye to this and had no disturbance in his heart. After ten years of loneliness, he has long been accustomed to being alone. He never expects the kindness of others, let alone the so-called following the crowd. A truly strong man never needs to be surrounded by others. Standing on his own, he is a towering tower.
When they arrived at the martial arts hall, dozens of descendants of the same generation from the Hou family were already gathered in the venue, arranged on both sides in an orderly manner. In the past, the martial arts arena was loose and noisy. Today, the atmosphere was particularly solemn and depressing. Everyone's eyes were vaguely focused on Shen Yan at the entrance.
At the head of the queue on the left, Shen Hao was dressed in a luxurious white brocade military uniform. His face was cold, and there was still lingering anger and humiliation in his eyes. He was severely reprimanded by Mrs. Liu last night and suppressed all impulses for revenge. At this moment, he seemed to be standing calmly, but in fact he was tense and stared at Shen Yan who was slowly entering the arena.
The several direct descendants of the third family next to him all had unkind expressions on their faces, with obvious hostility and provocation in their eyes, forming a vague encirclement.
Zhao Kun, the deacon of the Yanwu Hall, is a veteran martial artist at the seventh level of body tempering. He has been in charge of the rewards, punishments, and resource allocation of the Hou Mansion Yanwu Hall for many years. He has always been smooth in dealing with things and relies on the influence of the three houses. He was promoted by the Liu family. At this moment, he looked serious, standing on the high platform, his eyes swept across the whole place, and finally settled on Shen Yan, with an undisguised and deliberate indifference.
Shen Yan knew in his heart that, as he expected, today's suppression would start with the rules and resources of the martial arts hall.
Not long after, the morning bell fell and the twilight hour officially began.
Zhao Kun held the roster in his hand and called the names in a deep voice, his voice loud and clear, which spread throughout the audience. The process was orderly until the last person. He slowly raised his eyes and his eyes fell on Shen Yan, who was standing alone without a queue to rely on.
"Shen Yan, yesterday you staged a private fight in the martial arts field, disturbed the rules of the hall, and destroyed the martial arts atmosphere. Your penalty for this month will be halved, and your qualification for distributing body tempering pills this month will be cancelled."
As soon as he finished speaking, the whole place fell into silence.
There was no interrogation, no confrontation, no verification of the whole story, just a simple sentence of "private fighting and harassment", and he was directly convicted and punished.
Everyone present knew very well that yesterday's incident was clearly caused by Shen Hao's unprovoked provocation and deliberate frame-up. Shen Yan was passively defensive throughout the whole process and never took the initiative to cause trouble. But now the person in charge of the rules favors Sanfang, and right and wrong are completely reversed.
Rules are set by people. If people's hearts are biased, rules can become a weapon to hurt people.
Shen Hao's lips curved into a vague sneer, his eyes full of pride and sarcasm. This was his mother's method. She didn't need to take action or make grudges. She could legitimately suppress her opponents with just the power in her hands, leaving Shen Yan speechless.
The disciples all around bowed their heads, and no one dared to speak out to argue. Everyone remained silent, acquiescing to this unfair punishment.
Shen Yan was the only one in the audience who remained tall and straight, with a calm expression, without any trace of panic or anger.
He raised his eyes and looked at Zhao Kun on the high platform. His voice was cold and steady, neither high nor low, and could be heard clearly throughout the entire martial arts arena: "May I ask the deacon? Article 3 of the hall rules clearly states that passive self-defense and resisting provocations are not regarded as private fights and will not be punished. Everyone witnessed the whole process yesterday. It was Shen Hao who led people to surround, frame up for no reason, and took the lead. I was just protecting myself, so how can I talk about a private fight?"
Every word is clear, every sentence is well-founded, and it accurately adheres to the express rules of the martial arts hall, without even the slightest bit being unreasonable.
Zhao Kun's expression was slightly stiff. He obviously did not expect that Shen Yan, who had always been silent, would dare to contradict him in public and openly question the court rules and punishments. A trace of displeasure flashed across his eyes, and then he said coldly: "No matter what the cause, the fight has become a fact. It is a violation to disturb the order of the martial arts hall. Under the rules, only the results are important, not the trivial process!"
Strong words, arrogant and oppressive.
Everyone present heard it clearly and knew in their hearts that this was naked targeting and suppression. But no one dared to question the authority of the deacon, and no one dared to offend the three-room power behind it.
A faint cold light flashed across Shen Yan's eyes, and thoughts were flowing rapidly in his heart.
Zhao Kun's move seemed to be a temporary decision, but in fact it was Liu's arrangement last night. First, in the name of the lightest punishment, deduct his most urgently needed body-tempering elixir, cut off his key resources for breaking through the realm, and at the same time test his bottom line and courage.
If he swallows his anger, he will be deemed to be still cowardly and can be bullied, and the subsequent suppression will be stepped up step by step. All his resources, experience, and skills will be intercepted, and he will eventually be trapped and die in the fifth level of body tempering, with no possibility of advancement.
If he resists fiercely, he will be charged with contempt for the hall rules, contradicting the deacons, and arrogance and disobedience. The crime will be increased to one level and he will be completely deprived of the qualification to practice martial arts in the martial arts hall. The gain outweighs the loss.
One is soft and the other is strong, two dead ends, traps at every step, and calculations at every level.
Liu's methods were delicate, meticulous, watertight, and extremely vicious.
If it were an ordinary young man, he would either endure the humiliation and let himself be manipulated, or he would have his blood boiling and fall into a trap. But what Shen Yan was good at during his ten years in the city was breaking out of desperate situations and going against the trend.
He was never impulsive or aggressive, but he never swallowed humiliation.
title_en: Chapter 3: Rules are like a knife, fighting to break the situation Chapter 4: Seeking opportunities in dangerous mountains at night
